```yaml
name: Release: Cut

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to release (e.g., 1.2.3)'
        required: false

jobs:
  cut_release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Get current version
        id: get_version
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" ]; then
            echo "VERSION=${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            # Extract version from pyproject.toml or setup.py
            VERSION=$(python -c "import importlib.util; spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('meta', 'pyproject.toml'); meta = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(meta); print(meta.__version__)" 2>/dev/null || echo "0.0.0")
            echo "VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Create release/candidate branch
        run: |
          git checkout -b release/candidate
          git push origin release/candidate

      - name: Update release-please config
        run: |
          sed -i 's/"target-branch": "main"/"target-branch": "release\/candidate"/' .github/release-please-config.json
          git add .github/release-please-config.json
          git commit -m "chore: update target branch to release/candidate"
          git push origin HEAD

      - name: Trigger release-please workflow
        run: |
          gh workflow run release-please.yml -r ${{ github.repository }} --ref release/candidate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
